property.name: amoro_user
property.description: Amoro service user.

property.name: amoro_log_dir
property.description: Directory of the Amoro Management Service and optimizer logs.

property.name: amoro_pid_dir
property.description: Directory of the Amoro PID files.

property.name: amoro_data_dir
property.description: Amoro working directory (state files of the service actions).

property.name: amoro_conf_dir
property.description: Amoro configuration directory (config.yaml, jvm.properties, env.sh, log4j2.xml).

property.name: amoro_server_heapsize
property.description: Heap of the Amoro Management Service (MB). Recommended from the memory of its host.

property.name: amoro_optimizer_group
property.description: Optimizer group (resource group) created by Ambari, running its optimizers in the Optimizer Container. Tables are optimized by the group of their catalog.

property.name: amoro_optimizer_managed
property.description: If set to Yes, Amoro keeps Optimizer Min Parallelism threads running in the optimizer group of Ambari (dynamic-allocation.min-parallelism): it starts the optimizers, and starts new ones when they die. If set to No, the group keeps no minimum: start and release its optimizers from the Amoro dashboard.

property.name: amoro_optimizer_container
property.description: Where the optimizer started by Ambari runs: "local", a process on the Amoro Management Service host, or "spark", a Spark application on YARN (requires YARN and Spark3; the Spark3 client is added to the Amoro host). Recommended: spark when the cluster has YARN and Spark3.

property.name: amoro_optimizer_yarn_queue
property.description: YARN queue of the Spark optimizer (Optimizer Container: spark).

property.name: amoro_optimizer_spark_driver_memory
property.description: Memory of the driver of the Spark optimizer (MB, Optimizer Container: spark). Its executors run one optimizing thread each, with the Optimizer Memory.

property.name: amoro_optimizer_parallelism
property.description: Optimizing threads Amoro keeps running in the optimizer group (dynamic-allocation.min-parallelism): it starts optimizers when fewer threads run, for instance after an optimizer died. Spark container: the maximum number of executors of the optimizer. Recommended from the cores of the Amoro host, or from the YARN capacity.

property.name: amoro_optimizer_memory
property.description: Memory per optimizing thread (MB). Local container: an optimizer process gets its threads x this memory. Spark container: the memory of each Spark executor, which runs one thread. Recommended from the Amoro host, or from the YARN container limits.

property.name: amoro_admin_ldap_group_dn
property.description: Distinguished name of the LDAP group whose members administer Amoro (dashboard role SERVICE_ADMIN). The other LDAP users get the read-only VIEWER role.

property.name: amoro_truststore_path
property.description: Truststore of the certificates Amoro trusts on its outbound TLS connections (Polaris, Ranger, OIDC provider). Required when the dashboard TLS is enabled.

property.name: amoro_truststore_password
property.description: Password of the truststore, required to read the certificates of a PKCS12 truststore. Required when the dashboard TLS is enabled. Ambari gives the server a JKS copy of the truststore, readable without a password.

property.name: amoro_oidc_client_id
property.description: Client of Amoro in the cluster OIDC provider, set by Ambari when OIDC is enabled (oidc.json): Amoro authenticates to Polaris with it.

property.name: amoro_oidc_client_secret
property.description: Secret of the OIDC client of Amoro, managed by Ambari (credential store alias amoro.oidc.client.secret).

property.name: amoro_ozone_s3_secret
property.description: S3 secret of the Amoro user on the Ozone S3 gateway, used by the Polaris Ozone catalog of Amoro and applied with ozone s3 setsecret when Amoro starts. Ambari generates it when Amoro or Ozone is installed (Ozone > Actions > Rotate S3 Secrets replaces it); a value set here is kept.

property.name: amoro_oidc_auth_server_url
property.description: Issuer URL of the cluster OIDC realm, set by Ambari when OIDC is enabled.

property.name: content
property.description: Environment of the Amoro Management Service and of its optimizers (conf/env.sh).
